note: Santander Consumer Bank's notice on the credit check, under the Data Protection Authority's decision of 12 December 2007 (K600.033-018/0002-DVR/2007): the KSV1870's small-loan register keeps data five years to the day after a debt is paid in full following arrears (three months where paid properly, seven after a settlement or insolvency). No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.
